clips.title: The story
paras: In Gnomeregan, the fallen city's records lie beyond troggs and radiation. Master Mechanic Castpipe in Ironforge sends you to recover a Prismatic Punch Card through the terminals' layers of clearance.

Gnomeregan's fall to troggs and radiation drove its people from the city, leaving centuries of research, schematics, and civic records behind. Matrix Punchograph terminals still line its technological corridors, managing security clearance and storing files. Master Mechanic Castpipe in Ironforge's Tinker Town wants those punch-encoded archives recovered from the city's depths.

Gnomish mainframes demand clearance in stages. Begin with a White Punch Card among the wreckage outside the inner gates. Insert it into the Matrix Punchograph 3005-A in the Train Depot to make a Yellow card, then take that to the 3005-B terminal in the Dormitory for a Blue card. Model 3005-C advances it to Red. The final terminal, 3005-D, waits in the Engineering Labs, where the Red card becomes a Prismatic Punch Card.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: When we fled Gnomeregan, we left so much data behind! Vitally important data!

I need the data on a prismatic punch card, from a Matrix Punchograph 3005-D high security terminal, deep in Gnomeregan. You must access the terminal, but to do that you first need clearance... And to get that you must access lower security terminals-- models -A, -B and -C. And to do THAT you need security punch cards, starting with white... And we left all the punch cards in the city.
It's a catastrophe! Can you help?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the prismatic punch card??

clips.title: Completion
paras: You did it! You found the prismatic punch card and recovered the lost data! Vitally, critically, immeasurably important data that we could not live another moment without!
Your service to the gnomes will be long remembered, friend.
